project.title: Backyard Deck
project.subtitle: New freestanding wood deck
project.use: Freestanding residential deck, 2'-6" above grade. Not attached to the house.

geometry.source: Sizes and layout as given by the owner. Member sizes are the owner's proposal, to be confirmed by the engineer.

summary.headline: A 16 × 12 deck on six posts.
summary.text: New freestanding wood deck in the back yard: six posts on concrete footings, two beams, joists at 16 in. on centre and deck boards. It does not attach to the house.
summary.howToRead: Start with the picture, then the steps. The plan and section give sizes and locations, and the details show each connection. Anything in red is waiting on the engineer.
summary.sequenceNote: The sequence is for orientation only. Means, methods and site safety are the contractor's responsibility. Hold points shown here are in addition to the inspections required by the building department.
summary.reserved: The engineer's standard general notes go here: governing code and edition, design loads, lumber species, grades and preservative treatment, fasteners and connectors, concrete and soil bearing, and inspections. They are not part of this draft.

facts.s: Top of deck above grade, verify

steps.title: Lay out and pour the footings
steps.text: Set out the six footings from the plan. Footing size, depth and reinforcing: {footing}
steps.hold: Footing inspection before concrete is placed.

steps.title: Posts and beams
steps.text: Set each (N) PT 6×6 post on its post base, plumb, and brace it. Set the (N) (2) 2×10 beams on the posts. Beam to post: {postCap}

steps.title: Joists
steps.text: (N) 2×8 joists at 16 in. o.c. over the beams, with a rim joist at each end. Joist to beam: {joistToBeam}

steps.title: Decking
steps.text: (N) 5/4×6 deck boards across the joists. Guards and stairs are not part of this set: {guards}

scope.text: Six concrete footings. Size, depth and reinforcing: {footing}
Pressure-treated 6×6 posts on post bases. Base and anchor: {postBase}
2×8 joists at 16 in. o.c. with 5/4×6 decking.

notes.title: Scope
items: New freestanding wood deck. The deck is not attached to the house and takes no support from it.
Work marked **(N)** is new work under this permit.

notes.title: Framing
items: **Footings.** Concrete, six locations. Size, depth and reinforcing: {footing}
**Posts.** Pressure-treated 6×6 on post bases. Base and anchor: {postBase}
**Joists.** 2×8 at 16 in. o.c. Joist to beam: {joistToBeam}
